meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代谢网络通量,预测基因敲除对细胞的影响
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在代谢工程或系统生物学中需要模拟基因敲除的影响。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze metabolic network fluxes and predict gene knockout effects.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you model metabolism and need gene knockout simulation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能读取生物的代谢模型并做模拟计算:预测生长速率、模拟敲除基因后的影响,以及为达到目标生长找出所需营养。输出是这些数值或表格。
howto.when: 当用户提供或要求读取/构建代谢模型,并要做生长预测、基因敲除、营养需求等模拟分析时触发。

say.text: 给自带大肠杆菌模型跑一次 FBA,报告生长速率。
say.note: 会做一次通量平衡分析并给出目标值。

say.text: 在这个模型中把基因 b0008 敲除,重算生长速率。
say.note: 会返回敲除前后的生长对比。

say.text: 用最小培养基功能,给出达到最大生长 50% 的培养基。
say.note: 会返回最少需要的培养基组分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read metabolic models and simulate metabolism: predict growth rate, check the effect of gene knockouts, and find nutrients needed to support a target growth.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the task involves reading/building metabolic model files, or when users ask for simulations such as growth prediction, gene knockout, or nutrient/media requirements.

say_en.text: Run FBA on the bundled E. coli model and report the growth rate.
say_en.note: Performs flux balance analysis and returns the objective value.

say_en.text: Knock out gene b0008 in this model and rerun the growth calculation.
say_en.note: Returns growth before and after the knockout.

say_en.text: Use the minimal-medium function to suggest a medium supporting 50% of max growth.
say_en.note: Returns the minimum required medium components.
